findings.evidence: `Nebentypus/Independence.lean:108` provides `twistedHeckeSlashSum_eq_sum_of_rightCosets`; `HeckeSlash/ModularForm.lean` exposes the corresponding public lemmas `coe_heckeSlashModularFormEnd_eq_sum` and `coe_heckeSlashCuspFormEnd_eq_sum`, while this file ends after only the two `_coe` lemmas at lines 183 and 188.
findings.fix: Import `Nebentypus/Independence.lean` and add modular-form and cusp-form `coe_*_eq_sum` lemmas derived from `twistedHeckeSlashSum_eq_sum_of_rightCosets`, parallel to the untwisted endomorphism API.
findings.issue: Both public `twistedHeckeSlash*CharEnd` definitions are characterized only through the implementation-selected `twistedHeckeSlashSum`, so users cannot rewrite their action using an arbitrary right-coset decomposition.

summary: The new bundled endomorphisms lack the representative-independent characterization supplied by the parallel untwisted API.
